decisions.text: type pie: fractions of the total are the message: a pie, which shows ½, ⅓ and ¼ at a glance and announces the whole (G1.36)
slices largest first, clockwise from 12 o'clock: Moderate risk, Very high risk, High risk, Low risk, Very low risk
each slice its own colour, handed out in slice order (D-22 (a)): Moderate risk series-1, Very high risk series-2, High risk series-3, Low risk series-4, Very low risk series-5
each slice named outside it, its value under the name, formatted as one set (G7.27, D-51 (ii)): 38%, 23%, 21%, 16%, 2%
leaders to Low risk, Very low risk (a zero, a slice under 8°, or a label moved from its place; G7.29, D-34)
no outlines: true gaps 1.0 pt wide between the slices (G7.26s: 0.7 % of the diameter)
